purpose: Frozen golden payloads for writing-quality pilot (no production coupling)
notes: Each request mirrors POST /api/v2/generate-card body fields used by /try packing.
Guest scenarios: empty relAnswers; required signOff per Sprint 8D.2A.

Scenarios with flow=authenticated_body use richer relAnswers only. They do NOT send recipientId or x-user-id, so assembleRecipientContext / contextSupplement is not exercised (same generate-card route, body-path only).
avoidList values must be product AVOID_OPTIONS only.
Always score the single first-returned card per successful scenario (20 cards total). No three-version aggregation.
